items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: In Howard, they were the two trumpet players, George Lewis, Lawrence Marrero, Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: Who were the best banjo players here in New Orleans when you were young, when you were a kid, even before you took it up? Can you, anybody that you watched or liked?
Well it was a fella, there were two fellas that I know, one of them was one of those Marrero, but it wasn't Lawrence.
